title: Glowing scooter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow1' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#00ffff' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#00ffff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glow2' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff66ff' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff66ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glow3' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffff00' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffff00' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura behind the scooter -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='38' ry='24' fill='#00ffff' opacity='0.15'/>

  <!-- Rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='11' fill='#555577'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#8888cc' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='5' fill='#8888cc'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='2' fill='#bbbbee'/>

  <!-- Front wheel -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='11' fill='#555577'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#8888cc' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='5' fill='#8888cc'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='2' fill='#bbbbee'/>

  <!-- Deck (footboard) -->
  <rect x='30' y='62' width='36' height='7' rx='3' fill='#ff66ff'/>
  <rect x='30' y='62' width='36' height='3' rx='2' fill='#ff99ff'/>

  <!-- Deck glow -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='65' rx='20' ry='6' fill='url(#glow2)'/>

  <!-- Body / stem structure -->
  <path d='M60 62 L62 40 L72 38 L72 42 L64 44 L62 62 Z' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <path d='M60 62 L62 40 L66 39 L64 61 Z' fill='#ffdd44'/>

  <!-- Front fork -->
  <path d='M72 58 L72 72' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 58 L70 72' stroke='#ffdd44' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Handlebar post -->
  <rect x='65' y='30' width='10' height='8' rx='2' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  <rect x='65' y='30' width='10' height='3' rx='1' fill='#ffdd44'/>

  <!-- Handlebar -->
  <rect x='55' y='28' width='30' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff66ff'/>
  <rect x='55' y='28' width='30' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ff99ff'/>

  <!-- Handlebar grips -->
  <rect x='52' y='27' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#00ffff'/>
  <rect x='82' y='27' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#00ffff'/>

  <!-- Headlight -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='47' r='5' fill='#ffff00'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='47' r='5' fill='url(#glow3)'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='47' r='3' fill='#ffffaa'/>

  <!-- Headlight beam -->
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='47' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#ffff00' opacity='0.2'/>

  <!-- Glow sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='50' r='2' fill='#00ffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#ff66ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='25' r='1.5' fill='#ffff00' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='65' r='1.5' fill='#00ffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='65' r='1.5' fill='#ff66ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='15' r='1.5' fill='#ffff00' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Ground glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='35' ry='4' fill='#00ffff' opacity='0.12'/>
</svg>
